name: building-blocks-progress-atoms
title: Progress Atoms
description: Small Tailwind progress primitives for tracks, segments, steps, status meters, and completion cues.
useWhen: Small Tailwind progress primitives for tracks, segments, steps, status meters, and completion cues.
avoidWhen: Avoid progress atoms when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Progress Atoms uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
